decisions.reason: The fouling detection automation launched only a year ago and builds on the firm's heat exchanger core, so with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, management will keep it while results remain uncertain.
A web tool for weir dimensioning costs little to maintain, supports sales of the established business and uses little slack, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The fouling detection system complements the core equipment line and is still too new to judge against aspirations, so organisational slack lets the firm carry it for another year.
